source_text: וְ/הָ/אֲמֻצִּ֣ים יָצְא֗וּ וַ/יְבַקְשׁוּ֙ לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ לְ/הִתְהַלֵּ֣ך בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לְכ֖וּ הִתְהַלְּכ֣וּ בָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/תִּתְהַלַּ֖כְנָה בָּ/אָֽרֶץ׃
english_snapshot: And the strong ones came out and sought to go[a], to walk throughout the earth. And he said, “Go[b], walk throughout the earth,” and they walked throughout the earth.

signals.text: Or “the dappled ones” (traditionally, a color designation for the horses/teams); the Hebrew as pointed in the Masoretic Text more naturally reads “the strong ones.”

source_text: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י הַשְׁלִיכֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֶל הַ/יּוֹצֵ֔ר אֶ֣דֶר הַ/יְקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָקַ֖רְתִּי מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וָֽ/אֶקְחָ/ה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף וָ/אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֹת֛/וֹ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶל הַ/יּוֹצֵֽר־־׃
english_snapshot: Then Yahweh said to me[a], “Throw it to the potter—the magnificent price at which I was valued by them.” So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw it into the house of Yahweh[b], to the potter.

signals.text: Hebrew 'the potter.' Some interpreters propose 'the treasury' here because of the difficult context and the New Testament's use of this passage, but the Masoretic Text reads 'potter' in both places.

source_text: וְ/נַסְתֶּ֣ם גֵּֽיא הָרַ֗/י כִּֽי יַגִּ֣יעַ גֵּי הָרִים֮ אֶל אָצַל֒ וְ/נַסְתֶּ֗ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר נַסְתֶּם֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הָ/רַ֔עַשׁ בִּ/ימֵ֖י עֻזִּיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/בָא֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔/י כָּל קְדֹשִׁ֖ים עִמָּֽ/ךְ־־־־־־׃
english_snapshot: And you will flee by the valley of my mountains[a], for the valley of the mountains will reach to Azal. Yes, you will flee as you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then Yahweh my God will come[b], and all the holy ones with him.

source_text: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יֵצְא֤וּ מַֽיִם חַיִּים֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם חֶצְיָ֗/ם אֶל הַ/יָּם֙ הַ/קַּדְמוֹנִ֔י וְ/חֶצְיָ֖/ם אֶל הַ/יָּ֣ם הָ/אַחֲר֑וֹן בַּ/קַּ֥יִץ וּ/בָ/חֹ֖רֶף יִֽהְיֶֽה׀־־־׃
english_snapshot: And on that day living waters will flow out from Jerusalem[a], half of them to the eastern sea and half of them to the western sea[c][b]; it will be so in summer as well as in winter.

signals.text: That is, the sea to the east of Jerusalem, traditionally identified as the Dead Sea.
